title: Human decision
description: A researcher's decision on a review case. A decision case takes the decision document: Markdown with YAML front matter (decision.schema.json) whose body is the reason, and `supersedes` for a correction. A failure case takes `retry` or `stop` with the failure revision and a reason. The service allows promote only on a pass verdict, and failed only for a stopped unit.

document.description: The decision document; decision cases only.

evidence_revision.description: The exact failure revision decided on; failure cases only.

action.description: `retry` runs the failed phase again; `stop` sends the unit to be written up, and its decision is then `failed`. Failure cases only.

supersedes.description: Earlier decision this one corrects; decisions are never edited.
